author: tech_consumer_23
text: <p>Just tried to checkout 3 times with my credit card on Shopify store and kept getting 'payment authorization failed' error. Support chat disconnected twice. This is ridiculous for a $200 order.</p>

author: saas_engineer_87
text: <p>Our entire team has been locked out of Slack for 45 minutes. Status page shows everything operational but no one can login. This is costing us thousands in lost productivity.</p>

author: mobile_gamer_42
text: <p>Latest update to the banking app crashes immediately on launch. Tried clearing cache, reinstalling, nothing works. 2.3 rating on Play Store now. Fix your QA process!</p>

author: smarthome_enthusiast_15
text: <p>My Philips Hue lights keep disconnecting from the bridge every 20 minutes. Support told me to restart the router 5 times already. Never buying smart home products again.</p>

author: logistics_manager_66
text: <p>Package marked as delivered but nothing at the door. FedEx photo shows someone else's doorstep. $400 headphones gone and they won't even start an investigation until 7 days.</p>

author: product_hype_38
text: <p>Finally got my hands on the new gaming laptop after waiting 3 months. RGB is broken, trackpad is loose, battery lasts 2 hours instead of 8. Complete disappointment.</p>

author: customer_service_victim_91
text: <p>On hold with Amazon support for 1 hour 47 minutes. Agent finally picked up, transferred me, and got disconnected. They promised a callback 3 hours ago. Nothing.</p>

author: subscription_user_54
text: <p>Adobe charged me $89.99 for a subscription I canceled 6 months ago. Support says they'll refund in '5-7 business days'. Meanwhile, my account is still showing as active.</p>

author: feature_requester_77
text: <p>Why can't Spotify just add a 'sort by release date' option? It's been 10 years and hundreds of requests on the forum. They add pointless stuff like AI playlists instead.</p>

author: food_delivery_customer_29
text: <p>Ordered dinner at 7pm, it's now 9:15pm. Driver marked it as delivered but nothing here. Support just says 'sorry for the inconvenience' and gives $5 credit. My order was $45.</p>

author: fintech_user_63
text: <p>My PayPal account got locked for 'suspicious activity' - I bought a $50 game. 4 days now and verification team hasn't responded. My business payments are stuck.</p>

author: streaming_subscriber_88
text: <p>Netflix is buffering constantly at 480p despite having 1Gbps fiber. 4K plan is $22/month and I'm watching pixelated mess. Other streaming services work fine.</p>

author: ecommerce_shopper_34
text: <p>Tried PayPal checkout on Etsy - payment went through but order didn't show in my account. Took 2 days for them to find the transaction. Site said 'try again' and I ended up double charged.</p>

author: saas_admin_19
text: <p>Salesforce has been down for 3 hours in the EU region. All our sales reps can't access leads or contacts. Support is completely unresponsive. This is a critical outage.</p>

author: mobile_user_56
text: <p>Instagram app just closes whenever I try to upload a story. Updated to latest version, rebooted phone. Happening to all my friends too. Meta needs to fix this bug.</p>

author: smart_device_owner_72
text: <p>Nest thermostat went offline randomly and won't reconnect. Sitting in 90°F heat while support makes me try the same troubleshooting steps for the 5th time.</p>

author: package_recipient_45
text: <p>UPS delivered a crushed box with shoe prints on it. The laptop inside is completely destroyed. They're refusing to compensate because 'packaging wasn't adequate' - it was in the manufacturer's box.</p>

author: tech_enthusiast_93
text: <p>Was super excited for the new Apple Watch Ultra 2. Heart rate monitor is inconsistent during workouts, always shows 40bpm when I'm dying at 180. $800 for this.</p>

author: support_ghosted_11
text: <p>Emailed Dell support 9 days ago about my $3000 XPS laptop that won't boot. No response. Called twice, each time they said 'escalated to tier 2' and I never hear back.</p>

author: billing_victim_67
text: <p>My Disney+ subscription went from $7.99 to $15.99 without any notification. When I asked for the old price back, they said 'the promotion ended'. Never signed up for a promotion!</p>

author: feature_request_82
text: <p>When will Notion add an offline mode? I travel frequently and the app is useless without internet. It's the most requested feature for 4 years now.</p>

author: food_delivery_complaint_38
text: <p>DoorDash driver took 2 hours to deliver cold pizza. Blamed 'traffic' - I live 0.7 miles from the restaurant. Also missing the drinks I paid extra for.</p>

author: fintech_frustrated_54
text: <p>Coinbase locked my account when I tried to transfer $500 to my wallet. Support says it's a 'security hold' but won't tell me what's suspicious. It's been 10 days.</p>

author: streaming_issues_76
text: <p>Hulu has been choppy and keeps dropping to 360p for a week now. Chat support told me to 'reset my modem' - I'm a network engineer, it's definitely their CDN issues.</p>

author: payment_failure_41
text: <p>Walmart checkout with Klarna said 'payment method declined' but I see the charge on my bank app. Cart emptied and now the items are sold out. Really disappointing.</p>

author: saas_down_29
text: <p>Our AWS EC2 instances have been unstable for 6 hours. Auto-scaling groups not working, instances terminating unexpectedly. Support tickets are at 4 hours wait time.</p>

author: app_crasher_88
text: <p>Spotify crashes every time I try to open a specific playlist. Tried restarting phone, reinstalling app. 1.2 million users have this issue based on the forum thread.</p>

author: smarthome_issues_33
text: <p>My smart lights keep turning on at 3am randomly. Support says it's 'user error' because I probably set a schedule. I've checked - there's no schedule. I'm losing sleep over this.</p>

author: delivery_damage_57
text: <p>Amazon delivered my TV today. The box looked like it was used as a soccer ball. Opened it - cracked screen. Return process wants me to 'pack it securely' - how when the original packaging is destroyed?</p>

author: product_hype_victim_19
text: <p>The AI-powered kitchen gadget from Kickstarter finally arrived. It's basically a $400 timer with an app that crashes constantly. Creator hasn't responded to comments in 3 months.</p>

author: support_waiter_73
text: <p>AT&T support has left me on hold for 2 hours. The automated system keeps saying 'your wait time is approximately 5 minutes'. I've been transferred to 4 different departments.</p>

author: billing_dispute_26
text: <p>QuickBooks charged me $250 for 'payroll processing' on a plan that doesn't include payroll. Support said it will take 45 days to dispute. That's half my business budget.</p>

author: feature_wish_84
text: <p>I would literally pay extra for a dark mode in Gmail for web. It's 2026 and Google's accessibility options are a joke. Thousands of users have requested this.</p>

author: food_order_problem_22
text: <p>Uber Eats delivered my sushi to the neighbor's house AGAIN. Driver took a photo of the wrong door with a different welcome mat. Support says 'we'll contact the driver' - never hear back.</p>

author: fintech_issue_49
text: <p>Venmo won't let me transfer $300 to my bank account. Says I need to 'verify my identity' - I've been verified since 2018. Support is just bots, no one picks up.</p>

author: streaming_subscriber_12
text: <p>Paramount+ is a joke. Ads in the middle of shows even with 'Premium Plus'. Video quality is worse than YouTube from 2010. Canceling right now.</p>

author: checkout_issue_65
text: <p>Been trying to buy concert tickets on Ticketmaster for an hour. Payment keeps getting 'declined' despite trying 3 different credit cards. Contacted bank - they said no declined transactions on their end.</p>

author: saas_outage_18
text: <p>GitLab is down globally. Our CI/CD pipeline is blocked, 50 developers can't push code. Status page hasn't been updated for 2 hours. This is an absolute nightmare.</p>

author: mobile_ui_bug_77
text: <p>The phone app on Android has a glitch where the keypad doesn't register touch. Have to restart the phone to make a call. This bug has existed since Android 14.</p>

author: smarthome_fail_41
text: <p>My Ring doorbell went offline 3 days ago. Won't reconnect even with new batteries and resetting Wi-Fi. Support is asking me to pay $199 for a replacement. It's 14 months old.</p>

author: package_lost_83
text: <p>DHL says my package is 'out for delivery' for 4 days straight. Tracking shows it's been sitting at the local depot but they claim it's on the truck. Customer service number disconnects after 10 minutes.</p>

author: hype_disappointment_37
text: <p>The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7 is great in theory but terrible in practice. My screen has a crease line after 3 weeks and Samsung says it's 'normal wear and tear'. $1900 phone!</p>

author: support_ignore_52
text: <p>I've been trying to cancel my SiriusXM subscription for 2 weeks. They say 'call during business hours' - I call and wait 40+ minutes, then they hang up. This is theft.</p>

author: overcharge_victim_91
text: <p>My internet bill went from $49.99 to $89.99 last month. Provider says the 'promotional period ended' - but I never had a promotion. My contract says $49.99 for 24 months, I'm on month 8.</p>

author: feature_need_28
text: <p>Please give us a 'mark all as read' button for Reddit messages. I have 800+ unread because I can't be bothered to click each one. This is basic UI/UX.</p>

author: delivery_late_64
text: <p>Postmates driver accepted my order, waited 20 minutes, then cancelled. 3 different drivers did this over 2 hours before the restaurant closed. No dinner and I was charged a $15 cancellation fee.</p>

author: fintech_hold_76
text: <p>My crypto exchange has had a 'withdrawal hold' for 14 days on $5000. They're not responding to tickets, phone line is busy. The funds are just frozen for no reason.</p>

author: streaming_quality_33
text: <p>Peacock is a nightmare. I'm watching the Olympics and it buffers every 30 seconds. My internet is 500Mbps. The app crashes every commercial break. NBC should be ashamed.</p>

author: payment_error_87
text: <p>Apple Pay keeps failing at Walmart even though it works everywhere else. The cashier looks at me like I'm broke. I have $3000 in my account but the terminal says 'declined'.</p>

author: saas_performance_15
text: <p>Our Zendesk has been loading slowly for a week. It takes 30 seconds to open a ticket. Support says it's 'our internet' - we have dedicated fiber for the whole office.</p>

author: mobile_crash_59
text: <p>The stock trading app Robinhood crashes every time I try to execute a limit order. Sold at market price and lost $200 because I had to act fast. I'm switching platforms.</p>

author: smarthome_frustration_22
text: <p>My Roborock vacuum is now a brick. It won't connect to Wi-Fi after the latest firmware update. Customer support says they'll 'escalate to engineers' and I've been waiting 2 weeks.</p>

author: logistics_issue_68
text: <p>Ordered tires from TireRack. They arrived 2 days late, which is fine, but one tire is completely bald. Warehouse sent a used tire instead of new. Waiting on return label for 3 days.</p>

author: product_launch_flop_44
text: <p>The new Meta VR headset was supposed to revolutionize gaming. My unit overheats within 30 minutes, controllers disconnect randomly, and the battery lasts an hour. Such a letdown.</p>

author: support_ghosting_91
text: <p>Samsung's chat support has left me on 'we'll respond shortly' for over an hour while I can see them typing and stopping. Three times now. They're just ignoring me.</p>

author: billing_confusion_37
text: <p>I have two active subscriptions to Spotify Premium on the same account. One for $9.99 and one for $10.99. Support cannot figure out why. I've been double charged for 9 months.</p>

author: feature_request_53
text: <p>Microsoft Teams desperately needs a 'mute everyone except host' feature. We've been asking for years and they add meme reactions instead of practical features.</p>

author: food_delivery_miss_76
text: <p>JustEat delivery was 45 minutes late, food was cold, and the burger had no patty. Just bun, lettuce, and sauce. Driver said 'I don't check the bags' when I complained.</p>

author: fintech_lockdown_24
text: <p>My Wise account has been locked for 'review' after I transferred $1000 to my business partner. I've been a customer for 4 years with $50K+ in transactions. This is ridiculous.</p>

author: streaming_buffering_88
text: <p>Amazon Prime Video pixelates every 15 minutes like clockwork. Support suggested I 'close other tabs' - I have a 16-core CPU with 64GB RAM. It's clearly their streaming backend.</p>

author: checkout_frustration_62
text: <p>Target's app won't let me use my gift card balance with Apple Pay. It tries to charge my card full amount instead of using balance. Support told me to 'use the website' - I'm shopping in-store!</p>

author: saas_outage_49
text: <p>HubSpot has been inaccessible for 3 hours. Our marketing team can't send scheduled emails. The support hotline just says 'we're experiencing high call volume' and disconnects.</p>

author: mobile_glitch_34
text: <p>Google Maps keeps freezing while navigating. I missed my exit twice this week. It's a known issue on Pixel 7 but Google hasn't fixed it in 18 months.</p>

author: smarthome_incompatible_71
text: <p>My Google Home can't connect to my LG TV even though it's 'compatible'. Works for 5 minutes then loses connection. LG support blames Google, Google blames LG. No one helps.</p>

author: delivery_damaged_56
text: <p>USPS delivered my Amazon order in a box that was wet and falling apart. Inside, the book has water damage throughout. It's a $95 textbook and I need it for class tomorrow.</p>

author: hype_disappointed_32
text: <p>The new DJI drone is a disaster. GPS lock takes 10 minutes, camera stabilization is shaky, and it forgot my return-to-home settings mid-flight. Crash landed in my neighbor's yard.</p>

author: support_hell_85
text: <p>I'm in a loop with Verizon support: call, automated system, transfer to human, hold 30 mins, they escalate, get disconnected. Repeat. 6 days now. My phone has been dead.</p>

author: overcharge_angry_17
text: <p>My water bill is normally $90. This month it was $350. Utility company claims I have a 'leak' but my meter shows normal usage. They won't send anyone to check.</p>

author: feature_urgent_67
text: <p>Why is there still no two-factor authentication for Twitter? The 'security' option is a joke. I've been hacked twice and all support says is 'enable 2FA' - IT DOESN'T EXIST.</p>

author: food_late_83
text: <p>Delivery driver for Grubhub said 'be there in 5 minutes' 45 minutes ago. The app shows him parked 2 miles away for 30 minutes. My food is definitely cold. Support offered $2 credit.</p>

author: fintech_frozen_44
text: <p>Stripe has held $8000 from my sales for 180 days due to 'risk review'. I run a legitimate SaaS business with thousands of customers. Their risk team is impossible to contact.</p>

author: streaming_lag_70
text: <p>Disney+ has been loading content at the speed of dial-up. The 4K HDR is a myth - it's pixelated garbage. Their support said to 'improve my internet' while I'm on 2.5Gbps fiber.</p>

author: payment_issue_58
text: <p>Tried to use PayPal on Newegg. It redirected me to a 'confirm payment' screen that never loaded. Refreshed and it said 'order placed' but no confirmation email. Bank shows charge.</p>

author: saas_bug_23
text: <p>Our project management tool Asana is showing phantom tasks. I keep seeing tasks that don't exist when I use the mobile app. Web version is fine. Support hasn't acknowledged this bug.</p>

author: mobile_memory_91
text: <p>The phone runs out of memory with just 5 apps open. I have 12GB RAM, this shouldn't happen. Some memory leak in Android OS, Samsung says it's Google's problem.</p>

author: smarthome_connectivity_37
text: <p>My garage door opener MyQ disconnects from Wi-Fi every 2 days. Have to reconfigure from scratch each time. Chamberlain says it's 'interference' - I live in a rural area with 2 Wi-Fi networks nearby.</p>

author: package_missing_64
text: <p>FedEx claims my package was delivered and signed for by 'R. Smith'. I don't know any R. Smith and I was home all day. The signature is a squiggle. Customer support is non-existent.</p>

author: product_fail_26
text: <p>The $500 air fryer from that viral brand stopped working after 1 month. The display is frozen, buttons don't respond. Brand's support link is broken. Complete scam.</p>

author: support_frustration_82
text: <p>HP support is an absolute joke. I called about a dead laptop, got transferred 7 times, and each agent asked for the same info. 3 hours later they said 'send it in for repair' with a $150 diagnostic fee.</p>

author: subscription_rip_15
text: <p>I just noticed Audible charged me $14.95/month for a subscription I canceled in 2019. That's $800+ in charges. Support says they'll only refund 3 months. I'm livid.</p>

author: feature_needed_49
text: <p>WhatsApp desperately needs message scheduling. I work with international clients and I don't want to message them at 2am. Telegrams had this 5 years ago. Get with the times.</p>

author: food_delivery_bad_55
text: <p>Seamless driver took my order, marked it delivered, but never came. The photo he submitted was a picture of the sidewalk. Support just gives me a partial refund and says 'we'll investigate'.</p>

author: fintech_block_31
text: <p>My Revolut account got blocked after I attempted to buy $200 in crypto. I've been trading for years with them. They want a 'source of funds' - it's my salary, you have my payslips.</p>

author: streaming_issue_67
text: <p>YouTube TV has a bug where it drops audio sync on every channel. Restarting the app fixes it temporarily then it goes bad again. Support says 'we're aware' - been aware for 6 months.</p>

author: checkout_problem_44
text: <p>Nike's checkout page is broken on mobile. When I try to enter my credit card, the screen scrolls down automatically. I've given up trying to buy those limited edition shoes.</p>

author: saas_unsupported_78
text: <p>Freshdesk's new UI update is horrible. Now takes 3x longer to respond to tickets. We've complained and they said 'we're not rolling back changes'. Customers are angry about slow responses.</p>

author: mobile_slow_29
text: <p>My phone takes 10 seconds to open the camera now. Used to be instant. It's a OnePlus with flagship specs. This is planned obsolescence with the latest update.</p>

author: smarthome_privacy_63
text: <p>My Amazon Echo randomly starts talking at 3am. It 'heard something' according to the app. No one was here. I'm concerned about privacy and support doesn't care.</p>

author: delivery_insurance_57
text: <p>My $2000 camera was 'lost' during shipping. UPS is offering $100 insurance because I didn't buy extra coverage. They lost it, I shouldn't lose $1900. Small claims court is the next step.</p>

author: hype_dud_41
text: <p>The viral TikTok leggings turned out to be just regular leggings with a $50 price tag. The 'slimming technology' is just marketing. I feel scammed.</p>

author: support_robot_94
text: <p>I've been going in circles with Shopify's bot for 2 days. Keeps suggesting articles I already read. The 'contact support' button is hidden behind 5 clicks and then just redirects to the bot.</p>

author: billing_mistake_36
text: <p>My electric company sent a bill for $0 this month, then $200 next month. They made a 'billing adjustment' without telling me. When I called, they said 'you should have noticed'.</p>

author: feature_critical_72
text: <p>Microsoft Word still doesn't have a proper dark mode for macOS. The current one is gray, not dark. Users have been asking since 2018. Adobe has it, Google has it. Microsoft is behind.</p>

author: food_order_wrong_48
text: <p>Ordered a chicken sandwich, got a burger. No condiments, no fries I paid for. Driver's phone is off. Chownow support wants a photo of the food. I sent it 2 hours ago. No response.</p>

author: fintech_limbo_77
text: <p>My wire transfer from Chase to my investment account is 'pending' for 5 days. Chase says it's sent, investment account says not received. $10,000 in limbo. Neither bank takes responsibility.</p>

author: streaming_cancellation_21
text: <p>I tried to cancel my HBO Max subscription but the 'cancel' button is disabled with a message saying 'manage through your provider'. I subscribed directly, not through a provider.</p>

author: payment_declined_59
text: <p>Google Pay declined my transaction at a coffee shop. The shop says 'tapped again' and it worked. But I got two alerts for the charge. Bank shows one pending. I'm confused and frustrated.</p>

author: saas_data_loss_13
text: <p>Our Notion workspace was wiped yesterday. Support says they're 'restoring from backup' but it's been 14 hours. We have 50+ clients depending on this data. This is unacceptable.</p>

author: mobile_permission_68
text: <p>A legitimate app asked for location permission, I declined, and now the app just closes. No explanation, no warning. This is the 3rd app this week with the same behavior.</p>

author: smarthome_setup_45
text: <p>Setting up a TP-Link smart plug took 45 minutes because the app keeps saying 'incorrect password' when it's right. I changed the password 4 times. It worked eventually but what a waste.</p>

author: logistics_annoyance_89
text: <p>The tracking number for my package has been 'label created' for a week. Company says 'it's with the courier'. Courier says 'we haven't received it'. No one knows where my $500 order is.</p>

author: product_failure_56
text: <p>My Anker power bank died after 4 charges. It won't charge or discharge. Anker support said to 'try a different cable' - I've tried 6 cables. They're sending a replacement but want the broken one back. Shipping costs more than the item.</p>

author: support_redirection_73
text: <p>I've been redirected 8 times by PayPal support. Started with general support, then resolution center, then billing, then technical issues, then back to general. 4 hours wasted.</p>

author: subscription_chaos_28
text: <p>Amazon Prime charged me $139 annually even though I canceled after the free trial. It was 2 days after the trial ended. They refunded me but it's been a month and the refund hasn't posted.</p>

author: feature_ask_83
text: <p>I'm begging Instagram to add a 'temporarily deactivate' option for accounts. Not everyone wants to permanently delete to take a break. This simple feature would save so much frustration.</p>

author: food_quality_37
text: <p>Got a delivery from a restaurant I love. The food arrived cold and the packaging was leaking. The driver had my order for 50 minutes but the restaurant was 10 minutes away. No compensation offered.</p>

author: fintech_freeze_52
text: <p>Binance froze my account because I moved $1500 between my own wallets. No explanation, no response from support in 8 days. My crypto is just sitting there inaccessible.</p>

author: streaming_audio_14
text: <p>The audio sync on Netflix is always off for HDR content. It's fine on non-HDR. Support says 'it's your soundbar' - my soundbar works perfectly with HDR on Prime Video. It's Netflix's issue.</p>

author: checkout_error_66
text: <p>Macy's website says 'payment cannot be processed at this time' but my credit card shows the hold. The items are now out of stock and customer service won't honor the sale price.</p>

author: saas_slowdown_31
text: <p>Our Monday.com is taking 20 seconds to load any board. I've got 5 boards open and it's unusable. Support says to 'archive old boards' - I did, still slow. This is a premium enterprise account.</p>

author: mobile_connectivity_75
text: <p>My phone keeps dropping calls when I'm at home. Full bars of 5G, but calls fail. Provider says it's the 'network congestion' - there are 3 people in my suburb. I'm switching carriers.</p>

author: smarthome_updates_39
text: <p>My August smart lock stopped working after a firmware update. I'm locked out of my apartment at 11pm. The only solution is to factory reset - which requires physical access. I'm sleeping at a neighbor's.</p>

author: package_delayed_50
text: <p>My order was supposed to arrive via 2-day shipping. It's been 10 days. Each day the tracking updates to 'delayed - weather exception'. I live in California, it's been sunny for 2 weeks.</p>

author: product_hype_backlash_22
text: <p>The Nothing Phone (2) is a gimmick. Glyph interface is cool for 5 minutes, then it's just a regular mid-tier phone with awful camera performance. Influencers hyped this to the moon.</p>

author: support_loop_81
text: <p>I've submitted 12 tickets to Facebook support over 6 months. They respond with the same copy-paste message: 'we're looking into it'. My hacked account is still hacked. Nobody cares.</p>

author: billing_increase_47
text: <p>My gym membership went from $30 to $45 without consent. They said 'cost of living adjustment'. No notification, no email. I only noticed because my credit card statement looked high.</p>

author: feature_critical_74
text: <p>Slack still doesn't have threaded replies in DMs. It's 2026 and we have to @mention in a separate message. This makes group conversations impossible to follow. It's a basic feature.</p>

author: food_missing_19
text: <p>Ordered a large pizza with extra toppings, got a small cheese pizza. Called the restaurant, they said 'the driver is coming back' - it's been 2 hours. I'm eating cereal for dinner.</p>

author: fintech_suspension_60
text: <p>Robinhood suspended my account for 'pattern day trading' even though I have over $25K in the account. The algorithm is broken and support is unreachable. I'm losing money because I can't trade.</p>

author: streaming_subtitle_85
text: <p>Hulu's subtitles are constantly behind the audio. I've reported this twice, they said 'we'll look into it'. Everyone I know has this issue. It's been 18 months.</p>

author: payment_processing_38
text: <p>I paid my dentist with CareCredit. They said the payment didn't go through, but my credit shows the charge. The dentist wants me to pay again or they'll send to collections. 3 phone calls and no resolution.</p>

author: saas_crash_84
text: <p>Our CRM software crashed during peak business hours. Lost all unsaved data for 100+ leads. Support says we should 'save more frequently' - the auto-save is supposed to work.</p>

author: mobile_battery_42
text: <p>The latest iOS update destroyed my battery life. My phone drains 50% in 2 hours of light use. Apple says to 'check battery health' - it's at 92% which is good. This update is a disaster.</p>

author: smarthome_issue_26
text: <p>My Eufy camera is showing someone else's feed. I can see a person walking in a different house. I'm freaking out about privacy and Eufy support doesn't believe me.</p>

author: logistics_consolidation_71
text: <p>Three different orders from the same company were shipped separately, all with tracking. They all arrived on the same day, in three different vehicles. What a waste of resources.</p>

author: product_launch_fail_67
text: <p>The new Tesla Cybertruck is a joke. The panels don't align, the steering wheel feels cheap, and the 'armor glass' chipped from a rock. $100K for this? I'm canceling my reservation.</p>

author: support_escalation_58
text: <p>I've been trying to escalate a complaint to a supervisor at Comcast for 3 days. Every agent says 'supervisor is busy, they'll call back' - no one calls back. This is their strategy to wear you down.</p>

author: subscription_confusion_33
text: <p>I have two Netflix accounts. How? No idea. I use one, but I see charges for both. Support says they're different email addresses but won't tell me what the other one is. They want me to figure it out.</p>

author: feature_request_99
text: <p>I need a way to sync my calendar across all Google accounts. I have 4 accounts for different businesses. Manually adding events is killing my productivity. This should exist already.</p>

author: food_delivery_charge_62
text: <p>Delivery fee was $4.99, service fee $3.50, and the driver kept the $5 tip. My $25 order became $40. The restaurant is 0.3 miles away. Delivery apps are a scam now.</p>

author: fintech_delay_47
text: <p>Chase is holding my $2000 check deposit for 10 business days. It's from a government account. I've been a customer for 15 years with 6-figure balances. They cited 'new account rules' - account is 15 years old!</p>

author: streaming_crash_53
text: <p>Peacock crashes after every episode on Roku. Have to restart the app each time. Roku says it's Peacock, Peacock says it's Roku. Meanwhile I'm paying $10/month for this?</p>

author: checkout_cart_19
text: <p>Best Buy had a deal for an OLED TV. Added to cart, entered payment, got error 'item no longer available'. Went back to product page - it's still available at the sale price. Can't checkout.</p>

author: saas_unsupported_feature_44
text: <p>Our team uses Jira and we desperately need a proper Gantt chart view. The current plugin is terrible, constantly breaks. Atlassian said they'll integrate one natively - been 3 years. Nothing.</p>

author: mobile_auto_update_88
text: <p>My phone auto-updated and now my banking app won't work. Says 'incompatible OS version'. Bank says 'wait for update, could be months'. It worked fine yesterday.</p>

author: smarthome_intermittent_14
text: <p>My Yale smart lock works 50% of the time. The other 50% I'm standing in the rain trying to get it to connect to Bluetooth. Yale replaced the lock once, still broken.</p>

author: delivery_expensive_69
text: <p>Shipping was $45 for a $70 item. It arrived 2 weeks late in a poorly packaged box. I want to return it but return shipping is $60. I'm stuck with an item I don't want.</p>

author: hype_failure_32
text: <p>The viral Stanley cup is just a thermos. $45 for a cup that leaks and scratches. TikTok made me buy it and I regret everything. Return process is a nightmare.</p>

author: support_unresponsive_77
text: <p>I sent PayPal an email through their contact form 9 days ago. No response. Sent a second one 5 days ago. Nothing. Their phone line says 'high call volume' and hangs up.</p>

author: billing_double_32
text: <p>Walmart double charged me for the same order. I got two pending charges on my account. One cleared, one is still pending. They say they can't cancel pending charges, it's 'up to the bank'.</p>

author: feature_improvement_61
text: <p>Spotify needs a 'exclude from recommendations' button for artists you don't like. I can't block certain artists, so my Discover Weekly is ruined by that one band I hate.</p>

author: food_delivery_issue_27
text: <p>Ordered 3 items, got 2, and the 2 I got were wrong. DoorDash support said 'refund in 3-5 days'. I paid $38 for one sandwich I didn't even order.</p>

author: fintech_compliance_85
text: <p>My Upwork account is 'under review' because I earned $2000 in a month. They want my ID, tax documents, and an explanation of services. I'm a writer. This is excessive.</p>

author: streaming_drm_39
text: <p>I paid $25 to rent a movie on YouTube. It gave me an error that I can't watch it because my display is too old and doesn't support HDCP. I'm on a 2023 4K TV. They refunded me but I wasted 2 hours.</p>

author: payment_link_64
text: <p>Received a payment link from a client via Stripe. Clicked it, got an SSL error. Client sent screenshot showing it works for them. I tried different browsers, devices - still SSL error. Lost a $5000 contract.</p>

author: saas_enterprise_12
text: <p>Our enterprise Slack has been having outages every week for a month. They upgraded our plan to 'priority support' but the only change is a faster chatbot response. I'm paying thousands for this.</p>

author: mobile_gesture_56
text: <p>The new gesture navigation on Android is terrible. Back gesture conflicts with side-drawer navigation in apps. I keep accidentally going back when I want to open menus. There's no option to disable.</p>

author: smarthome_voice_93
text: <p>Alexa can't understand my voice anymore after the 'voice training' feature. Used to work fine. Now she mishears every command. Support says 'retrain your voice' - didn't work.</p>

author: logistics_customer_service_17
text: <p>OnTrac customer service is impossible. Their phone number goes to a full voicemail. The live chat is a bot that gives irrelevant answers. My package has been 'in transit' for 8 days.</p>

author: product_disappointment_48
text: <p>Bought a 'waterproof' phone case that claimed '20ft depth rated'. Phone died in 3ft of water. Company says 'you didn't test it correctly'. How do you test incorrectly? You submerge it!</p>

author: support_training_84
text: <p>Xfinity support reads from a script and can't deviate. I ask a question not on the script and they say 'I don't understand'. They had to Google my issue on their own computer during the call. I heard the keyboard.</p>

author: subscription_cancel_55
text: <p>I've been trying to cancel my gym membership for a month. The app says 'call the branch'. The branch says 'call the corporate number'. Corporate says 'we can't cancel, you need to visit the branch'. I moved 1000 miles away.</p>

author: feature_missing_41
text: <p>Apple Music still doesn't have a 'sleep timer' in the app. Spotify has it, YouTube has it. You have to use a separate timer that stops the music with an alarm. It's basic functionality.</p>

author: food_compensation_76
text: <p>Uber Eats offered me $3 compensation for a $25 order that never arrived. I've escalated 5 times. Each time they increase it by $1. It's been 2 weeks and I've gotten $5 total. This is insulting.</p>

author: fintech_merchant_29
text: <p>Square held $2000 from my business for 30 days because they 'detected unusual activity'. It was Black Friday sales, I made 20 sales in one day. That's normal. They couldn't understand basic business.</p>

author: streaming_freezing_63
text: <p>Paramount+ freezes at 2:23 minute mark on every episode of Star Trek. I've rewatched the same 2 minutes 12 times. Support says 'clear cache' - didn't work.</p>

author: checkout_discount_37
text: <p>Applied a promo code for 20% off. Checked out, confirmation shows full price. Support says 'promo didn't apply' even though I have a screenshot showing it before checkout. They won't adjust.</p>

author: saas_migration_92
text: <p>Migrating from Trello to ClickUp lost 40% of our cards. Support says 'you didn't follow the migration guide properly'. The guide had 45 steps and 3 of them contradicted each other. My team is furious.</p>

author: mobile_privacy_50
text: <p>Apps are accessing my clipboard in the background. I tested it - copied a password and immediately TikTok opened a related ad. Google's clipboard access warning is useless because they don't enforce it.</p>

author: smarthome_integration_68
text: <p>My Philips Hue and Lutron lights don't play well together. Automations work 50% of the time. HomeKit says it's integrated, reality is a mess. I've spent $1000 on this system.</p>

author: delivery_packaging_81
text: <p>Amazon used a box 10x larger than my item with zero bubble wrap. The item was loose, bouncing around. It arrived broken. Fulfillment centers don't care about pack quality anymore.</p>

author: hype_wait_73
text: <p>Waited 8 months for the Hailey Bieber skincare launch. Made the order the second it launched. It's been 2 weeks, still hasn't shipped. Customer service says 'processing'. What takes 14 days to process?</p>

author: support_technology_42
text: <p>Bank of America's new AI assistant is useless. Asked to dispute a charge, it gave me a phone number. Called it, the automated system redirected me to the app. The app directed me to the chatbot. I'm in a digital hell.</p>

author: billing_communication_66
text: <p>My internet provider increased rates by $15. No email, no letter, no notification on the app. I only found out from the bill. They said 'terms allow rate changes with 30 days notice'. That notice never happened.</p>

author: feature_obsolete_28
text: <p>Gmail's label system hasn't evolved in 15 years. We need nested labels with color coding and the ability to hide labels with zero unread. I get 500 emails a day and this system is prehistoric.</p>

author: food_order_cold_94
text: <p>Food arrived 30 minutes after estimated time. Container was room temperature, fries were soggy, burger bun was stale. DoorDash gave a $4 credit. That's half the delivery fee, not the food.</p>

author: fintech_auth_37
text: <p>I've been locked out of my Fidelity account because of 2FA issues. The authenticator app code is always 'invalid' even though it's the right time. Support says 'sync your clock' - it's synced. 2 weeks locked out.</p>

author: streaming_recommendation_75
text: <p>Netflix's algorithm keeps recommending the same 5 shows. I've watched all of them already. It takes 20 scrolls to find something new. Their recommendations are broken.</p>

author: payment_authorization_54
text: <p>PayPal authorized my $700 purchase, the merchant shipped the item, and then a week later PayPal reversed the charge claiming 'unauthorized'. The merchant is asking me to pay again. My account is negative.</p>

author: saas_notification_19
text: <p>GitHub notifications keep marking themselves as read. I miss important comments on PRs because the notification disappears. Support says it's a 'known issue' but it's been happening for 2 years.</p>

author: mobile_storage_63
text: <p>My 'Other' storage category is 80GB on a 128GB phone. No way to clear it without factory reset. Apple support says 'it's system cache' but won't tell me how to remove it. I'm losing 60% of my storage.</p>

author: smarthome_consent_47
text: <p>My smart thermostat is collecting data on my location, energy usage, and when I'm home. The 'privacy policy' allows them to sell this data. I can't use the device without consenting. This is surveillance.</p>

author: logistics_update_58
text: <p>Tracking for my shipment says 'delayed - operational delay'. No explanation, no new date. Just stuck in the same city for 4 days. How can this happen with modern logistics?</p>

author: product_hype_limited_84
text: <p>Signed up for the waiting list for the limited edition sneakers. Got an email to buy them, clicked the link in 2 minutes. Already sold out. Scalpers bought them all. This system is broken.</p>

author: support_callbacks_29
text: <p>USAA support promised a callback in 2 hours. It's been 3 days. Called back myself, they said 'we tried to reach you' - I have no missed calls. They're lying.</p>

author: subscription_tier_71
text: <p>Spotify quietly removed the 'Hulu included' perk from the student plan. I'm paying the same price for less. No notification, no communication. I feel trapped.</p>

author: feature_workflow_56
text: <p>Airtable needs a proper undo button with history. I accidentally deleted a column with 1000 records. There's no way to recover it. This should be standard in 2026.</p>

author: food_delivery_policy_82
text: <p>The pizza place won't refund me for a wrong pizza unless I return it. Who returns a pizza? It's cheese and bread! I'm not driving 20 miles for a $15 refund. They know this.</p>

author: fintech_chargeback_45
text: <p>My bank charged me a $50 'chargeback fee' for a fraudulent transaction they also failed to prevent. They said 'it's the cost of doing business'. No, it's the cost of them not protecting me.</p>

author: streaming_offline_38
text: <p>Disney+ offline downloads expire after 30 days and you need internet to renew them. What's the point of offline if I need to go online to extend it? I'm flying international for 40 days.</p>

author: checkout_error_79
text: <p>I tried 5 times to check out at Modcloth. Error: 'payment method not accepted' each time. Called my bank, no holds, card works elsewhere. This is a site issue. Support was useless.</p>

author: saas_downtime_64
text: <p>Intercom was down during a scheduled product launch. We couldn't handle incoming queries. The launch was a disaster. Intercom apologized but also said 'we don't offer SLA credits'. Unbelievable.</p>

author: mobile_camera_22
text: <p>The camera app on my Google Pixel is amazing except for the 5-second lag to open. Missed every photo of my kid's first steps. Google says 'restart the app' - 5 times daily. This is a flagship phone.</p>

author: smarthome_compatibility_77
text: <p>My new smart fridge can't connect to my 2.4GHz Wi-Fi because it only supports 5GHz. This is a $3000 fridge. My router supports both. The manual says to 'change router settings' - I shouldn't have to reconfigure my home.</p>

author: delivery_confirm_36
text: <p>Package was signed for by 'H. Johnson'. I live alone and my name isn't Johnson. Called FedEx, they said 'it was delivered successfully'. No proof, no photo. Just 'trust the driver'.</p>

author: hype_down_58
text: <p>The viral Stanley tumbler has a straw that collapses and a lid that leaks. I paid $45 for a cup that doesn't hold liquid. The brand's return policy requires you to pay return shipping.</p>

author: support_disconnect_43
text: <p>Every time I get a live chat agent with Amazon, they disconnect after 5 minutes. I've had this happen 4 times today. I think their system is designed to frustrate you into giving up.</p>

author: billing_late_72
text: <p>My credit card payment was processed a day before the due date, but they posted it after the due date and charged a late fee. 3 hours difference cost me $29. They won't reverse it.</p>

author: feature_accessibility_94
text: <p>Twitter's accessibility is terrible. The contrast on the new UI is too low. I have a vision impairment and can barely read tweets. They removed the high-contrast option. I've complained 5 times.</p>

author: food_delivery_time_66
text: <p>It said '30-40 minute delivery'. Got a notification that the driver was picking up at 45 minutes. Then another at 1 hour. Then they cancelled. I ordered at 7pm, it's now 9:30pm and I have no food.</p>

author: fintech_balance_49
text: <p>My PayPal balance shows $450, but I can't send any money. The balance is on hold. When I try to use it, it says 'use your bank account instead'. What's the point of having a balance?</p>

author: streaming_interface_81
text: <p>Hulu's new interface hides the 'continue watching' behind a sub-menu. I have to click 4 times to resume a show. Why make the main action harder? This is UI design 101.</p>

author: payment_option_37
text: <p>The merchant only accepts payment through a third-party app that I need to install. I refuse to install yet another app. Lost a sale because you want my data. I'll shop elsewhere.</p>

author: saas_support_74
text: <p>Our Salesforce support tickets take 2 weeks for a response. We're paying $500/user/month for this? The response is always 'escalated' and then nothing for another week. Useless.</p>

author: mobile_notification_15
text: <p>Notifications are delayed by 15-20 minutes on my phone. I get messages in batches. This is after the latest system update. No way to fix it, I've tried everything. OnePlus says it's a 'feature' for battery life.</p>

author: smarthome_security_90
text: <p>My Ring doorbell was hacked. Someone talked to my delivery driver through it. Ring says 'we take security seriously' but won't tell me what happened. I'm unplugging all my smart devices.</p>

author: logistics_damage_62
text: <p>Ordered a glass table. It arrived shattered. Delivery guy said 'you should've selected fragile shipping'. It was in the product description as fragile. I paid extra for 'safe handling'. No refund yet.</p>

author: product_durability_38
text: <p>The $200 wireless earbuds lasted 4 months. One side stopped working. Brand says 'physical damage' - I literally used them at my desk. They won't replace. Never buying from them again.</p>

author: support_escalation_policy_53
text: <p>My issue is 'too complex for first-tier support'. They said it will take 72 hours for tier 2. It's been 2 weeks. I call back, they say it's still pending. No one knows what happened to my case.</p>

author: subscription_pricing_67
text: <p>My music streaming service increased from $9.99 to $12.99 because they added 'AI features'. I don't want AI features. I want music. Why can't I stay on the old plan?</p>

author: feature_customization_42
text: <p>LinkedIn keeps showing me irrelevant job recommendations. I've clicked 'not interested' on 50+ jobs. It ignores my preferences. This algorithm is trash.</p>

author: food_delivery_promo_31
text: <p>Grubhub sent a 40% off promo. I placed the order, it applied the promo, then the restaurant rejected the order. Reordered, this time no promo. Support says 'promo not available for reorders'. It's the same order.</p>

author: fintech_limits_76
text: <p>My credit card has a $5000 limit. I tried to buy a $4000 laptop, it was declined. Bank says 'fraud prevention'. I called and confirmed it was me. They said 'try again in 24 hours'. The sale ends today.</p>

author: streaming_audio_quality_28
text: <p>Spotify sounds terrible on my high-end DAC. It's clearly compressing the audio heavily. Tidal sounds amazing. I'm switching because Spotify doesn't care about audio quality.</p>

author: checkout_session_69
text: <p>Added items to my cart, started checkout, got distracted for 5 minutes. Came back and my cart was emptied. The site timed out my session. I had to restart. I gave up and bought somewhere else.</p>

author: saas_integration_81
text: <p>Our CRM integration with QuickBooks breaks every week. We lose the sync, support says 'reauthorize the connection'. We've done this 12 times. They won't fix the underlying issue.</p>

author: mobile_ads_50
text: <p>The free version of my podcast app shows an ad after every episode. I get it, you need revenue. But it's the same ad for a game I will never download. It's been a year. Change it up.</p>

author: smarthome_control_19
text: <p>I want to turn off the motion sensor on my outdoor lights but keep the schedule. The app makes no sense. 'Motion at night' is the only option. I want to separate these controls. UI is terrible.</p>

author: delivery_return_87
text: <p>I received the wrong item. The return process requires me to print a label. I don't have a printer. They said 'use a shipping store' - I have to pay $5 to return their mistake. Not fair.</p>

author: hype_reality_55
text: <p>The Oura Ring 4 is a glorified pedometer. $350 for sleep tracking that tells me I slept poorly. No actionable insights. It's just a data collector that sells your health data.</p>

author: support_availability_34
text: <p>I needed help at 10pm with a hardware issue. Support is open 24/7 but they sent me to a chatbot. The chatbot didn't understand. I had to wait until morning. Why advertise 24/7 if it's not true?</p>

author: billing_autopay_62
text: <p>I canceled autopay 2 months ago. They charged me again this month. Bank won't reverse it without proof of cancellation. My app shows 'autopay disabled' but they keep charging.</p>

author: feature_export_73
text: <p>Figma doesn't export designs with all layers properly. I have to manually fix the CSS every time. There's a plugin that does it but costs $15/month. This should be native.</p>

author: food_delivery_accuracy_88
text: <p>My order instructions were very clear: 'NO ONIONS'. I got onions. This happens 40% of the time. Restaurants don't read instructions. Delivery apps don't enforce it. I'm allergic.</p>

author: fintech_account_restore_16
text: <p>I restored my 2FA authenticator to a new phone. Now I can't log into my bank account. It says 'security risk'. I've been on the phone for 3 hours. They keep asking security questions I answered correctly.</p>

author: streaming_content_40
text: <p>I wanted to re-watch a classic movie on HBO Max. It's gone. Replaced by some reality TV show. Content licensing is ruining streaming. I'm going back to physical media.</p>

author: payment_confirmation_57
text: <p>I paid with Apple Pay and got a confirmation on my phone. The merchant says they don't see the payment. I have the receipt, the charge on my card. They want me to 'verify with your bank' before they deliver.</p>

author: saas_onboarding_93
text: <p>Our new team member can't onboard because the SSO integration is broken. IT support says it's a SaaS issue. SaaS support says it's an IT issue. 2 weeks, our new hire can't work.</p>

author: mobile_keyboard_35
text: <p>The keyboard covers up the input field in messages. I can't see what I'm typing. This happens in multiple apps. It's an OS bug from 2 updates ago. Still not fixed.</p>

author: smarthome_schedule_78
text: <p>My smart bulbs have a schedule that I can't disable. I have to delete and recreate it. The toggle doesn't work. This is basic software functionality. What were they thinking?</p>

author: logistics_handling_44
text: <p>The package arrived with 'FRAGILE' tape on it. They threw it over my gate. It was a laptop. The box was dented. Laptop works but screen has pressure marks. They don't care.</p>

author: product_quality_65
text: <p>The outdoor furniture was advertised as 'weatherproof'. After 2 months, the paint is peeling, metal is rusting. Manufacturer says 'normal wear and tear'. It's supposed to last 10 years.</p>

author: support_philosophy_82
text: <p>Customer support's philosophy is 'wear them down'. They hope you give up. I've been trying to get a $50 refund for 6 weeks. They ignore me until I call again. This is their strategy.</p>

author: subscription_trap_31
text: <p>I signed up for a $1 trial. They charged me $99 after 7 days. I canceled the same day I signed up. They said 'the trial ended' - it was a 7-day trial and I canceled on day 1.</p>

author: feature_unavailability_29
text: <p>The web version has features the mobile app doesn't. Why? I use both regularly. I'm paying the same. There's no parity. This is annoying.</p>

author: food_quality_decline_53
text: <p>The food quality at this restaurant has declined dramatically. They use less meat, more filler. Prices went up. Delivery still costs $6. They've lost a regular customer.</p>

author: fintech_authentication_67
text: <p>Two-factor authentication has a backup that uses a phone number I no longer have. To change the number, I need to 2FA with the old number. Infinite loop. Support isn't helpful.</p>

author: streaming_interface_slow_72
text: <p>The smart TV app is incredibly slow. Takes 10 seconds to scroll. It's not my TV - other apps work fine. They clearly don't test on older hardware.</p>

author: checkout_captcha_44
text: <p>I failed the CAPTCHA 6 times. I'm not a robot. The images are ambiguous. Finally got through and my items were out of stock. Great customer experience.</p>

author: saas_security_18
text: <p>Our company data was compromised because of a SaaS vendor's security lapse. They sent an email 2 weeks later saying 'we fixed it'. No details. We're at risk. Legal is involved.</p>

author: mobile_battery_health_56
text: <p>The 'battery health' feature says my capacity is 86%, but my phone lasts 4 hours. Clearly fake. I want a refund but Apple says 'battery is normal'. It's not normal.</p>

author: smarthome_frustration_83
text: <p>I have a smart home hub from 3 years ago. The company dropped support. It's a brick. $200 thrown away. They won't even unlock the local API so I can use it with open source.</p>

author: delivery_international_61
text: <p>International shipping took 3 weeks and cost $80. My package arrived, but it was opened. The customs form was stolen. Couldn't track it after it left the US. Terrible experience.</p>

author: hype_anticlimax_47
text: <p>Everyone was hyping this new productivity app. It's just a checklist with a nicer UI. Nothing new, no AI, no integrations. I wasted a week migrating.</p>

author: support_survey_24
text: <p>They ask for feedback after every support call. I gave feedback. Nothing changed. The survey is to make you feel heard, not to actually improve. It's a placebo.</p>

author: billing_increase_86
text: <p>My cloud hosting bill increased by 40% without usage change. They changed the pricing model and didn't tell me. I only noticed after 3 months. That's thousands of dollars overcharged.</p>

author: feature_voting_52
text: <p>The 'most requested feature' has been voted #1 for 2 years on their forums. It's still not implemented. Why do you even have a voting system if you ignore it?</p>

author: food_order_confirmation_39
text: <p>I got a confirmation email for my order. 2 hours later, the restaurant called to say they're out of stock and cancelling. The email was a lie. I wasted my evening waiting.</p>

author: fintech_historian_75
text: <p>My transaction history is only available for 24 months. I need records for tax audit. Bank says 'download before 24 months'. I didn't know. Now I can't access critical information.</p>

author: streaming_analytics_33
text: <p>The streaming app recommends the same content to everyone in the house. We have different tastes. It ruins the recommendations. This isn't personalized, it's generic.</p>

author: payment_processing_time_58
text: <p>My payment was processed, the merchant says they haven't received it. It's been 3 business days. Bank says to wait. I'm getting late fees from the merchant.</p>

author: saas_cancel_hold_41
text: <p>My SaaS subscription is active but I'm in the cancellation process. They still charged me for the next month. 'Cancel immediately' doesn't mean immediate. They charge for the 'billing cycle'. Deceptive.</p>

author: mobile_freezing_68
text: <p>My phone freezes randomly for 3-5 seconds. It happens 10+ times daily. I've done factory resets. Support won't RMA because it's 'within acceptable performance'. $1200 phone.</p>

author: smarthome_energy_89
text: <p>My energy monitoring device says I'm using 40% more electricity than the utility meter. I've calibrated it. It's broken. Support says 'user error'. I'm losing money trusting this device.</p>

author: logistics_status_46
text: <p>The status says 'out for delivery' since 6am. It's 8pm. The delivery window was 10am-2pm. I stayed home all day. No package, no update. It's just sitting on the truck.</p>

author: product_defect_12
text: <p>The product had a manufacturing defect. I requested a replacement. They sent another with the same defect. Quality control is non-existent. I'm going to the media.</p>

author: support_technical_competence_73
text: <p>The support agent didn't know what 'SSD' was. I had to explain it. How can you support tech products without knowing basic terms? This is a major tech company.</p>

author: subscription_auto_renew_64
text: <p>They charged me for an annual subscription that auto-renewed. I wanted to cancel but 'cancel' is greyed out. It says 'contact support'. Support says 'sign a cancellation form'. The form is broken.</p>

author: feature_data_analysis_35
text: <p>The data analytics dashboard doesn't have a proper export. I can screenshot but not CSV. What's the point of data if I can't analyze it externally? This is basic.</p>

author: food_missing_again_77
text: <p>Missing an item from my order again. This is the 4th time. You can't get a human on support. The chat bot does a partial refund but I want my food!</p>

author: fintech_holding_period_38
text: <p>Deposits have a 5-day holding period now. It used to be 2 days. They didn't announce it. Support says 'policy update'. I need access to my money.</p>

author: streaming_buffering_constant_82
text: <p>4K content buffers every 2 minutes. HD content works fine. Same bitrate. This is a CDN issue, not my internet. Why can't streaming companies get this right?</p>

author: checkout_guest_51
text: <p>I can't check out as a guest. I have to create an account. I don't want another account. I'm on 40+ apps. This is how you lose a sale.</p>

author: saas_data_migration_79
text: <p>We paid for a data migration service. 80% of the data is corrupted. Migration support says 'your data was formatted wrong'. We used their template. They're blaming us.</p>

author: mobile_os_update_44
text: <p>The OS update promised 'improved performance'. My phone is slower than ever. Benchmark scores dropped 20%. No way to rollback. They forced this on me.</p>

author: smarthome_intercom_90
text: <p>My smart doorbell intercom has a delay. I hear the visitor 5 seconds after they speak. It's not the network, it's the device. Support says 'replace it' - I bought it 2 months ago.</p>

author: delivery_schedule_37
text: <p>I scheduled a 10am-2pm delivery. Took a half day off work. It arrived at 6pm. The driver said 'I had other deliveries'. So why offer time windows you can't meet?</p>

author: hype_expectation_28
text: <p>The gaming chair was supposed to be ergonomic. It's hard, lumbar support is missing, armrests wobble. All YouTube reviews were paid. I fell for it.</p>

author: support_ticket_creation_66
text: <p>Creating a support ticket requires logging in, going to three menus, and filling out a long form. Why can't I just email support? They hide the contact info.</p>

author: billing_adjustment_52
text: <p>My account shows a credit of $12.50 from an overcharge 3 months ago. It never applied to my balance. Support says 'we don't see that' - I have the email. They're gaslighting.</p>

author: feature_layout_69
text: <p>The new layout is cluttered. Important features are hidden in sub-menus. Useless features are prominent. Who designed this? Do they use the product?</p>

author: food_delivery_late_night_81
text: <p>11pm, craving food. Only two places open. One is 'not accepting orders', the other has a 90-minute wait. The convenience of delivery apps is gone. They never have drivers at night.</p>

author: fintech_account_closed_43
text: <p>My account was closed without notice. I had $400 in it. They mailed a check which I never received. They're holding my money hostage. 3 months of back and forth.</p>

author: streaming_device_issues_54
text: <p>The app on my Apple TV freezes at the end of every episode. I have to restart the entire Apple TV. It's only this app. I've reinstalled 3 times.</p>

author: payment_confirmation_delay_70
text: <p>I got a confirmation email but the money is still pending on my bank. It's been a week. The merchant is holding the order. 7 days is too long for a $50 purchase.</p>

author: saas_dashboard_47
text: <p>The dashboard has so many widgets you can't find anything. Customization is limited. The data is there but it's overwhelming. This is bad UI.</p>

author: mobile_cellular_data_32
text: <p>My phone uses cellular data randomly even when on WiFi. I used 2GB this week on my WiFi at home. Support says 'turn off WiFi assist' - it's off. Bug.</p>

author: smarthome_motion_detection_78
text: <p>The motion sensor triggers on every leaf. False alarms constantly. I turned sensitivity to minimum. Still triggers. The app doesn't have an 'ignore small objects' option.</p>

author: logistics_delivery_photo_25
text: <p>The delivery photo is a picture of the inside of the truck. How does that confirm delivery? The driver is clearly scamming. Support says 'we'll investigate'. No follow up.</p>

author: product_warranty_84
text: <p>The warranty is 1 year but the product broke at 13 months. They won't help. 30 days out of warranty and it failed. This is planned obsolescence.</p>

author: support_communication_59
text: <p>They communicate through email only. I responded within 5 minutes. They respond the next day. A single issue takes 2 weeks for 3 emails. I can't call them.</p>

author: subscription_difficulty_17
text: <p>Downgrading from Pro to Basic shouldn't be hard. The 'downgrade' button is hidden. To find it, you click 'cancel', then 'keep basic', then confirm. Confusing.</p>

author: feature_priority_46
text: <p>They add new features but ignore bug fixes. I have 3 critical bugs that crash the app. They added a dark mode instead. I don't want new features, I want stability.</p>

author: food_delivery_fee_73
text: <p>The $15 coupon required a $25 minimum. My order was $24. They made me add a $5 item I didn't want. Then the coupon applied but my total was higher than without it. Scam.</p>

author: fintech_fraud_alert_62
text: <p>My card was used fraudulently. I reported it immediately. They sent a new card in 7 days. The investigation takes 90 days for $200. That's my grocery money.</p>

author: streaming_season_removal_80
text: <p>I was mid-season on a show. They removed it with 1 episode left. I'll never know the ending. This is why people pirate. Streaming is unreliable.</p>

author: checkout_promo_code_39
text: <p>The promo code won't accept. It says 'invalid' but I copied it from their email. Tried 10 times. Gave up. I saved $0 because the site can't process codes.</p>

author: saas_user_management_53
text: <p>User management is impossible. I can't assign roles properly. The UI is confusing. I accidentally gave admin to a new hire. This is a security risk.</p>

author: mobile_volume_issue_45
text: <p>The volume controls on the phone are independent of the app. Media volume vs call volume. I adjust the wrong one constantly. This is unintuitive.</p>

author: smarthome_cloud_dependency_87
text: <p>My smart lights won't work without internet. Why? They're local devices. The company wants to control you. This is a cloud dependency that's unnecessary.</p>

author: delivery_package_theft_66
text: <p>Stolen package from my porch. Delivery photo showed it there. Police report filed. Seller says 'delivered, not our problem'. I'm out $300. No one helps.</p>

author: hype_backlash_34
text: <p>Everyone recommended this restaurant. The food was overpriced, small portions, and not good. I wasted $80 on a date. Influencers are lying to us.</p>

author: support_avail_42
text: <p>24/7 support means overseas call centers that don't understand my issue. I asked for a refund, they said 'restart your computer'. I asked for a supervisor, they said 'one moment' and hung up.</p>

author: billing_cycle_71
text: <p>My subscription renews on the 1st. I canceled on the 2nd. They charged me the full month. Support says 'you missed the deadline'. It's 1 day. This is predatory.</p>

author: feature_legacy_56
text: <p>They removed the legacy version. The new version is missing features I need. No option to stay. Now I have to find a competitor. Legacy users were ignored.</p>

author: food_restaurant_issue_24
text: <p>The restaurant gave me a 20% discount for 'inconvenience' because they forgot my order for 45 minutes. The discount was a QR code that expired that day. I couldn't use it.</p>

author: fintech_mobile_app_88
text: <p>The mobile app has 2.3 stars on the App Store. I ignored it. Now I see why. It crashes, doesn't show balances, and the fingerprint login fails 5 times before working.</p>

author: streaming_download_quality_33
text: <p>Downloads are 720p only. I have 4K plan. Why can't I download 4K? Storage is cheap. This is a restriction that makes no sense. I'm on a plane for 16 hours.</p>

author: payment_authentication_60
text: <p>3D Secure verification took me to a page that didn't load. It timed out. The merchant's support says 'try another card'. I tried 3. All failed. This is a security system that stops legitimate purchases.</p>

author: saas_contract_trap_15
text: <p>Yearly contract with automatic renewal. I tried to cancel 60 days before. They said '50 days or less has fees'. I was 10 days late. $500 cancellation fee. This is a trap.</p>

author: mobile_glitch_text_91
text: <p>My texts get sent out of order. I type 'No, I'll be late', it sends 'I'll be late, No'. This is a known bug for my phone. 6 months and no fix. Embarrassing.</p>

author: smarthome_battery_life_22
text: <p>My smart door sensor battery lasts 2 weeks instead of 2 years. It's the only one dying quickly. Support says 'replace it' - I've done 3 replacements. The device is flawed.</p>

author: logistics_support_72
text: <p>I call the courier hotline. It's an AI that repeats the tracking info. I already have the tracking info. I want to speak to a person. There's no way to bypass the AI.</p>

author: product_assembly_49
text: <p>The furniture took 4 hours to assemble. Instructions were unclear. Parts were mislabeled. I have 2 extra screws. Is the table going to collapse? No support on weekends.</p>

author: support_response_time_58
text: <p>The first response took 48 hours. It was a generic 'we'll look into this' email. I replied immediately. It's been 72 hours. No response. This has been going on for a week.</p>

author: subscription_refund_policy_64
text: <p>They said 'no refunds' in the terms. But the service was broken for 3 months. They said they'd fix it. I waited. Now they say 'you passed the refund window'.</p>

author: feature_migration_36
text: <p>They announced a new feature but won't migrate my old data. I have to start fresh. I've been a customer for 5 years. This is how you treat loyal users?</p>

author: food_contactless_83
text: <p>The driver left the food at the apartment building entrance. Not my door. Contactless delivery is great but they should leave it at the door. Someone stole my groceries.</p>

author: fintech_apr_increase_29
text: <p>My APR increased from 18% to 29% despite paying on time. The reason? 'Market conditions'. This is predatory. I've never been late. Closing the account hurts my credit.</p>

author: streaming_subtitle_delay_67
text: <p>Subtitles are 30 seconds ahead of the dialogue. I tried every language. It's a sync issue. Support says 'turn subtitles off and on' - doesn't fix it.</p>

author: checkout_receipt_50
text: <p>My receipt is in the app only. I can't download a PDF. I need it for expense reports. Support says 'screenshot it' - that's unprofessional. Just give me a button.</p>

author: saas_performance_degradation_44
text: <p>The app performance degrades throughout the day. I restart it at lunch, it's fine. By 4pm it's slow. Memory leak. Support denies it. I've got proof.</p>

author: mobile_orientation_74
text: <p>The app locks to portrait mode. I want landscape. I use a keyboard. Why restrict orientation? This is lazy development.</p>

author: smarthome_updates_forced_39
text: <p>They force updates through the app. The update broke my settings. I've set up automations 3 times now. Every update resets them. I'm exhausted.</p>

author: delivery_time_frame_63
text: <p>They gave a 4-hour window. 8am to 12pm. It's now 2pm. No one came. I can't leave the house. This is a hostage situation with my package.</p>

author: hype_letdown_48
text: <p>The $200 smartwatch has an app that takes 30 seconds to sync. It's 2026, Bluetooth should be instant. The step counter overcounts by 1000 steps daily. Useless.</p>

author: support_kb_articles_75
text: <p>They send me knowledge base articles that don't solve my issue. I've read them all. They're for a different version. I even linked the specific article. They sent it again.</p>

author: billing_currency_conversion_31
text: <p>They charged me in USD even though I'm in EU. Their conversion rate was 10% higher than market. I asked for adjustment. They said 'it's our conversion fee'. Hidden fee.</p>

author: feature_integration_gap_52
text: <p>The integration with Zapier broke. They updated their API without warning. My automation stopped 2 days ago. I lost potential customers. No one told us.</p>

author: food_portion_size_68
text: <p>The portions got smaller again. This is the 3rd shrinkflation in 2 years. Prices went up twice. I'm paying more for half the food. I'm done with this place.</p>

author: fintech_interest_rates_40
text: <p>The savings interest rate is 0.01%. Inflation is 6%. I'm losing money by saving. All banks do this. There's no incentive to save.</p>

author: streaming_environment_55
text: <p>The app doesn't support airplay on my TV. It works on one TV but not another. Same brand. This is inconsistent. Why make it complicated?</p>

author: payment_cycle_77
text: <p>My bill is due on the 15th. They processed the payment on the 14th but posted it on the 16th. Late fee charged. I have proof of processing date. They don't care.</p>

author: saas_training_resources_33
text: <p>The training resources are videos from 2021. The UI has changed completely. I can't follow along. No updated resources. They expect me to figure it out.</p>

author: mobile_audio_lag_89
text: <p>Audio lag on Bluetooth headphones is 500ms. It's unwatchable. My phone doesn't have a headphone jack. I'm forced to use Bluetooth. This is a problem they should've solved years ago.</p>

author: smarthome_routines_43
text: <p>Routines don't trigger reliably. 70% success rate. I've rebuilt them 5 times. Support says 'make them simpler' - they are simple. Turn on lights at sunset. How simpler can it get?</p>

author: logistics_customs_81
text: <p>My package is stuck in customs for 3 weeks. They can't tell me why. No phone number, only email. They respond after 5 days with 'we're working on it'. It's a $50 item.</p>

author: product_build_quality_26
text: <p>The $700 espresso machine feels cheap. Plastic parts, flimsy buttons. The $300 one from another brand is metal. Why charge more for less?</p>

author: support_timezone_57
text: <p>Support is US Eastern time. I'm in Australia. My only option is late night calls. They don't have weekend support. A ticket takes 5+ days due to time zone.</p>

author: subscription_notification_92
text: <p>They emailed me 12 hours before renewal. I was asleep. I woke up to a charge. They should email 7 days before. This is deliberate so you forget to cancel.</p>

author: feature_documentation_38
text: <p>The feature is undocumented. I found it by accident. How many other features are hidden? The documentation is a skeleton. They don't want you to know everything.</p>

author: food_delivery_environment_47
text: <p>The driver didn't bring a thermal bag. Food was cold. The driver said 'it's just 10 minutes'. It was 30 because they took other orders first.</p>

author: fintech_benefits_cut_63
text: <p>They removed the cashback benefit. Now it's 'points for merchandise' only. I want cash. I'll use a different card. This loyalty program is a joke.</p>

author: streaming_short_lived_75
text: <p>I'm tired of shows being canceled after 1 season. Why invest time? Streaming services keep canceling good shows but renew garbage. I'm canceling all of them.</p>

author: checkout_bug_54
text: <p>The 'apply coupon' button is greyed out even though I have a valid code. I entered it correctly. There's no error message. It just doesn't work. I gave up.</p>

author: saas_mobile_optimization_66
text: <p>The web app isn't optimized for mobile. I have to pinch and zoom constantly. It's 2026, responsive design is standard. This is lazy.</p>

author: mobile_backup_issue_35
text: <p>My backup failed and I lost everything. The cloud backup says 'saved' but it's not. When I restored, it gave me 2023 data. 3 years of photos gone.</p>

author: smarthome_scenes_82
text: <p>The 'goodnight scene' turns on the bedroom lights instead of off. It's set correctly but the app has a bug. I've reported it 4 times. They won't fix it.</p>

author: delivery_address_error_49
text: <p>I entered the correct address. The system auto-corrected it to a similar street. My package went 2 miles away. The courier refuses to redirect. I have to wait 3 days.</p>

author: hype_environmental_59
text: <p>The 'eco-friendly' packaging is just marketing. Everything is still wrapped in plastic. I bought this brand for sustainability. They're lying.</p>

author: support_phone_waits_71
text: <p>I've been on hold for 55 minutes. The estimated wait was 5 minutes. They do this to make you hang up. I'm on a work phone, I can wait all day. They won't win.</p>

author: billing_consolidation_28
text: <p>I have 3 invoices for the same period. Each bill says 'total due'. I paid one. They say I owe all 3. They can't explain the duplication. I'll report them.</p>

author: feature_browser_issue_44
text: <p>The feature works on Chrome but not Firefox. You're a modern web app. Support Firefox. I shouldn't need to install a new browser. This is basic compatibility.</p>

author: food_delivery_cancellation_60
text: <p>They canceled my order without reason 5 minutes before delivery. No compensation. No explanation. I was hungry and had to wait 2 more hours. Never using them again.</p>

author: fintech_savings_goal_80
text: <p>The savings goal feature is broken. I set a goal of $1000. I deposited $1100. It says '90% complete'. I contacted support, they said 'it might be a display glitch'. So the numbers are fake?</p>

author: streaming_audio_sync_56
text: <p>Audio sync issues on every TV app. Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV - all have the same issue. It's not my hardware. It's their app. This is embarrassing.</p>

author: payment_mobile_donation_23
text: <p>I tried to donate $20 via mobile. The site loaded slowly and charged me 5 times. I got 5 confirmation emails. I'm on hold with my bank to dispute $100 in donations.</p>

author: saas_legacy_ui_37
text: <p>They updated the UI but kept some legacy elements. It's inconsistent. Some pages have the new design, some have the old. It's confusing. I never know where to click.</p>

author: mobile_wifi_calling_68
text: <p>WiFi calling doesn't work. It says 'enabled' but drops calls on WiFi. I asked support and they said 'use a different internet provider'. I have 1Gbps fiber. The problem is on your end.</p>

author: smarthome_geofencing_45
text: <p>The geofencing feature thinks I'm home when I'm 2 miles away. I've adjusted the radius. It still triggers incorrectly. My alarm turns off when I'm not there. Security risk.</p>

author: logistics_cost_vs_service_32
text: <p>Shipping cost $50 for 2-day delivery. It arrived in 5 days. No refund on shipping. The service didn't match the price. FedEx doesn't care.</p>

author: product_repair_72
text: <p>The product broke within warranty. Sending it for repair costs $45 shipping. I could buy a new one for $60. This warranty is pointless. A $15 discount? No.</p>

author: support_social_media_41
text: <p>I complained on Twitter and they responded in 2 minutes. I emailed support 3 days ago. They still haven't responded. Why is public shaming the only effective method?</p>

author: subscription_feature_lock_54
text: <p>I'm on the Basic plan. I can't even see the feature list for Pro. They hide it until you upgrade. I want to know what I'm missing before I pay. This is deceptive.</p>

author: feature_community_83
text: <p>The community forum is full of unfixed bugs from 3 years ago. The moderators lock threads without resolution. They don't want transparency.</p>

author: food_tipping_35
text: <p>The app added a 20% default tip. I didn't notice. I would've tipped 15%. They tricked me. Now I check every time. This is unethical.</p>

author: fintech_balance_update_67
text: <p>My balance updates once a day. I need real-time balances. It's 2026, transactions are immediate. Why can't my balance be immediate? This is archaic.</p>

author: streaming_interface_dark_46
text: <p>The dark mode is inconsistent. Some sections are dark, some are light gray. The background changes between apps. My eyes hurt. Just make it truly dark.</p>

author: checkout_stock_uncertainty_74
text: <p>The site said 'Only 1 left in stock'. I rushed to buy it. After checkout, they said 'backordered 2 weeks'. The stock indicator was fake to create urgency.</p>

author: saas_audit_trail_39
text: <p>The audit trail is missing critical logs. I can't see who deleted important files. The audit feature is broken. We need this for compliance. No response from support.</p>

author: mobile_duplicate_notifications_58
text: <p>I get 3 notifications for every message. Same message, 3 times. I've cleared cache. It's a bug from last update. They don't care. My phone is always buzzing.</p>

author: smarthome_energy_usage_49
text: <p>The energy usage report shows huge spikes at 3am when everything is off. The sensor is faulty. They won't replace it. My $200 device is useless.</p>

author: delivery_community_73
text: <p>My package was delivered to the community mailroom instead of my door. It's 20 minutes away. I ordered heavy items. Why not deliver to my apartment? Lazy driver.</p>

author: hype_quality_control_29
text: <p>The brand is popular but quality control is poor. Every item has a flaw. I returned 3 items from the same collection. They didn't check them before shipping.</p>

author: support_language_barrier_58
text: <p>The support agent spoke broken English. I struggled to explain my issue. They transferred me 3 times. Each agent had a different accent. No one understood.</p>

author: billing_minimum_requirement_47
text: <p>To get the advertised price, I had to sign a 2-year contract. I wanted month-to-month. That was double the price. This is deceptive advertising.</p>

author: feature_demo_restriction_64
text: <p>The demo version is useless. It doesn't show the actual workflow. I bought it based on the demo. The real product is completely different. I regret this purchase.</p>

author: food_order_cancellation_72
text: <p>Ordered during lunch rush. Restaurant called 40 minutes later to cancel. They were 'too busy'. Why accept orders if you can't fulfill them? Wasted my lunch break.</p>

author: fintech_annual_fee_44
text: <p>The annual fee increased from $95 to $195. Benefits stayed the same. No notice, just saw it on my statement. This is price gouging. I'll close the account.</p>

author: streaming_live_tv_issue_80
text: <p>Live TV is 30 seconds behind broadcast. I get score alerts on my phone before I see the play. This ruins sports. Why can't streaming be close to real-time?</p>

author: payment_duplicate_charge_56
text: <p>My card was charged twice. The merchant says 'pending charge will drop off'. It's been 10 days. Both charges are posted. I need my money. No one helps.</p>

author: saas_support_sla_32
text: <p>We pay for premium support with 1-hour SLA. Tickets take 6+ hours. We asked for a refund on support. They said 'SLA is best effort not guaranteed'. False advertising.</p>

author: mobile_contacts_sync_71
text: <p>Contacts sync duplicates everyone. I have 3 entries for the same person. I cleaned it once. It came back after the next sync. This has been an Android issue forever.</p>

author: smarthome_schedules_25
text: <p>The schedule lost all my timers. I had 15 timers for various lights. All gone after a firmware update. No backup. No warning. I'm redoing everything.</p>

author: logistics_address_parsing_38
text: <p>The address parser is broken. It split my address incorrectly. Package went to the wrong zip code. They tried to deliver to a non-existent address. Return to sender.</p>

author: product_comfort_fail_47
text: <p>The $150 office chair is uncomfortable. I've tried adjusting everything. Back pain after 1 hour. Reviews said 'best chair ever'. They're paid reviews.</p>

author: support_acknowledgment_83
text: <p>They acknowledged my issue and said 'we'll escalate'. That was 2 weeks ago. No update. I asked for an update, they said 'we'll look into it'. Loop.</p>

author: subscription_plan_change_55
text: <p>I changed from monthly to annual to save money. They charged me the annual fee plus the monthly fee in the same month. They said 'it's a billing system limitation'.</p>

author: feature_feedback_ignore_64
text: <p>I submitted feedback through their portal. It was well-written, detailed, with examples. They thanked me and closed it. 'Won't implement' was the status. Why ask for feedback?</p>

author: food_delivery_timing_37
text: <p>I scheduled a delivery for 7pm. It arrived at 5:30pm. I was still at work. Food was left at the door for 2 hours. This defeats the purpose of scheduling.</p>

author: fintech_fraud_prevention_58
