text: <p>The fraud prevention system is too sensitive. It flags every transaction over $100. I have to verify with a text every time. I've been a customer for 8 years. Trust me.</p>

author: streaming_auto_play_49
text: <p>Auto-play is broken. It skips the next episode and plays a random show. I've disabled auto-play and it still does it. Netflix, fix this. I'm tired of manually selecting.</p>

author: checkout_currency_issue_60
text: <p>The prices shown are in USD. Checkout converted to local currency. The exchange rate is terrible. I'd rather pay in USD. No option to choose.</p>

author: saas_onboarding_automation_41
text: <p>The onboarding automation is buggy. We have to manually trigger it for each customer. Support says 'we'll patch it soon'. It's been a year.</p>

author: mobile_photo_quality_76
text: <p>My photos look terrible in low light. Flagship phone, expensive camera hardware. The software processing ruins them. I regret buying this phone.</p>

author: smarthome_firmware_rollback_28
text: <p>The firmware update made my device worse. I want to rollback. They don't allow it. I'm stuck with a downgraded product. This is anti-consumer.</p>

author: delivery_multiple_attempts_52
text: <p>They attempted delivery 3 times. I was home every time. No doorbell, no knock. Just a 'we missed you' note. The driver is lying. This happens every time.</p>

author: hype_cease_31
text: <p>The hype for this product was manufactured. The reviews were influencer spam. The product is mediocre. I want my money back. Shame on them.</p>

author: support_automation_frustration_70
text: <p>The automated support just says 'I didn't understand that'. It doesn't learn. It's the same loop every time. I'm screaming at a bot. Where are the humans?</p>

author: billing_terms_34
text: <p>The terms and conditions changed. They said 'we'll notify you'. I never received notification. They changed the price and locked me in. I can't cancel without fees.</p>

author: feature_removal_63
text: <p>They removed a feature I used daily. It's gone. No replacement. They said 'we'll consider bringing it back'. My workflow is broken. I'm leaving.</p>

author: food_ingredient_quality_48
text: <p>The ingredients quality has dropped. Cheaper meat, less fresh vegetables. Same high price. I can taste the difference. I'm a loyal customer, not an idiot.</p>

author: fintech_credit_impact_77
text: <p>Bank closed my credit card due to 'inactivity'. 20 years of history gone. My credit score dropped 50 points. They said 'you can reapply'. That's not the same.</p>

author: streaming_ecosystem_44
text: <p>I have 5 streaming services. Content is fragmented. I can't find what I want. The search doesn't work across services. Someone needs to fix this.</p>

author: payment_gateway_timeout_55
text: <p>Payment gateway timed out. I refreshed and got charged twice. Gateway says 'no transaction'. Bank says 'two charges'. I'm stuck in the middle. 3 weeks no resolution.</p>

author: saas_email_notifications_38
text: <p>Email notifications are overwhelming. 50+ emails daily. There's no digest option. I can't disable specific notifications. It's all or nothing. I choose nothing.</p>

author: mobile_keyboard_prediction_59
text: <p>Keyboard predictions are worse. It autocorrects to the wrong word constantly. I've turned off predictions. They keep turning back on. This is infuriating.</p>

author: smarthome_setup_complex_86
text: <p>Setting up this smart system required 5 apps, 3 accounts, and 2 hours. It should be plug and play. This complexity is why smart home adoption is slow.</p>

author: logistics_delivery_promise_42
text: <p>They promise 2-day delivery. My order is day 8. Still in transit. They said 'weather delay' - it's sunny across the country. I'm being lied to.</p>

author: product_safety_concern_73
text: <p>The product has a safety recall. I registered it. They never contacted me. I found out on the news. My family's safety was at risk. This is negligence.</p>

author: support_feedback_loop_62
text: <p>They ask for feedback, I give it. They ask me to take a survey. I take it. Nothing changes. This is a feedback loop with no output. Wasted my time.</p>
